releaseTitle: ATalk v3.5.2 — Architecture & Structural Cleanup Release
releaseNotes:
• 01 Safe Dead Code Elimination: Purged obsolete and duplicate code modules (MediaPickerSheet.kt, MediaAttachmentSheet.kt) with zero regressions.
• 02 WebSocket-First Network Governor: Eliminated aggressive multi-loop REST polling (reducing HTTP requests from >100/min to idle 45s keepalive) whenever Supabase Realtime WebSocket is healthy.
• 03 Persistent Offline Outbox Queue: Encrypted AES-256 outbox queue storing unsent messages during offline blips with automatic FIFO dispatch upon network reconnection.
• 04 ChatRoom Modular Decomposition: Extracted floating capsules and dialogs (StarredMessagesDialog, DynamicIslandCallCapsule, ReactionParticleBurst) into ChatRoomModals.kt.
• 05 Unified Lightbox Architecture: Upgraded ContactDetailsSheet avatar viewer to use the high-fidelity AvatarLightboxDialog with zoom, pan, and tactile haptics.
• 06 Attachment Menu Unification: Retired dormant 8-tile drawer in favor of the ergonomic Contextual Radial Thumb-Radar.
